facts.fact: The Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026 (G.S.R. 527(E), Gazette dated 29 June 2026) superseded the Family Pension Scheme, 1971 and EPS-95
facts.quote: in supersession of the Employees’ Family Pension Scheme, 1971 and the Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995, except as respects things done or omitted to be done before such supersession

facts.fact: The e-Gazette copy of the EPS 2026 (CG-DL-E-30062026-273951) was digitally signed and uploaded on 30 June 2026
facts.quote: Digitally signed by SARVESH KUMAR SRIVASTAVA SRIVASTAVA Date: 2026.06.30 22:46:02

facts.fact: The current minimum monthly member pension, including relief, is Rs 1,000 (EPS 2026 para 12(8)); no official source shows a Rs 7,500 minimum or a start date for one
facts.quote: the member’s monthly pension including any relief payable to any existing or future member under this paragraph, shall not be less than one thousand rupees.

facts.fact: The Rs 1,000 minimum is subject to deductions for commutation/return of capital taken under EPS-95 before 26.09.2008 and for early pension
facts.quote: deductions on account of benefits of commutation and return of capital taken by members under the provisions of the erstwhile Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995 prior to 26th September, 2008; and (ii) deductions on account of early pension under sub-paragraph (7).

facts.fact: The minimum widow pension is also Rs 1,000 per month
facts.quote: in cases, where the monthly widow pension including relief, if any, is less than one thousand rupees per month, such pension shall be enhanced to one thousand rupees per month.

facts.fact: EPFO's EPS page says members need at least 10 years of eligible service for pension
facts.quote: Members with minimum 10 years of eligible service are entitled to pension; others may opt for withdrawal benefits or scheme certificate.

facts.fact: The government's 2025 Parliament reply acknowledges demands to raise the Rs 1,000 minimum pension but records no decision to raise it
facts.quote: Representations have been received from various stakeholders including trade unions and public representatives to increase the minimum pension under the Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS), 1995 from existing Rs. 1000/- per month.

summary: EPS 2026 para 12(8) keeps the minimum pension at Rs 1,000; no notice of Rs 7,500 found on pib.gov.in/labour.gov.in/epfo.gov.in (28 Oct 2026); no change.
